title: ecw-television-championship-ecw-sundaymania-1996
label: Hack Myers

won.source: The federation's own broadcast (promotions/ecw-sundaymania-1996/archive/extreme-sunday-mania-1996-02-18.html, msg_ids IoK7zatGKKwJ, cZ82tbdldscJ): an eight-man battle royal in which Hack Myers eliminates Chris Jericho, then Taz and Dick Dudley together, to become the last man standing and the promotion's first Television Champion.

how: Outlasted seven others in an eight-man battle royal to become the first champion.
note: The champion agrees on air to defend against a partner of 2 Cold Scorpio's choosing the following week; no further card survives in the held record.
